en.name: Non-Surgical Rhinoplasty (Liquid Nose Job)
en.meta_title: Non-Surgical Rhinoplasty: Instant Nose Reshaping with Fillers
en.meta_description: Instantly reshape your nose without surgery using a non-surgical rhinoplasty, or 'liquid nose job.' This 15-minute procedure uses dermal fillers to smooth bumps, lift the tip, and improve symmetry with no downtime.
en.meta_keywords: non-surgical rhinoplasty, liquid nose job, 15-minute nose job, nose filler, rhinoplasty alternative, nose reshaping, cosmetic injections

what_is.heading: What is a Non-Surgical Rhinoplasty? The 15-Minute Nose Job
paragraphs: A non-surgical rhinoplasty, often called a "liquid nose job" or "15-minute nose job," is a remarkable non-invasive alternative to traditional surgery. This procedure uses precisely injected hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers to instantly reshape and refine the nose. It is an excellent option for making subtle yet impactful changes without downtime.

applications.heading: What Can It Correct?
paragraphs: At LUNAI, our expert injectors can masterfully use fillers to smooth out bumps and humps on the nasal bridge, lift a droopy nasal tip, improve nasal symmetry, and create a more refined overall profile. The procedure is quick, typically taking less than 30 minutes, with minimal discomfort.

candidates_results.heading: Candidates and Immediate Results
paragraphs: Ideal candidates are those looking for minor to moderate adjustments. It's a perfect way to "try out" a new nose shape before committing to surgery. It is not suitable for reducing the size of the nose. The results are immediate and can last from 9 to 18 months, with virtually no recovery time.
